# Connection library ecosystem

Portline is the saved-connection library family. Start with an application below. Dockline supplies related transport and key tools; the shared packages support integration authors.

## FileZilla JS

FileZilla native settings, normalized profiles and explicit credential resolution.

[API documentation](https://h2ooooooo.github.io/filezilla-js/api/) · [CLI documentation](https://h2ooooooo.github.io/filezilla-js/cli/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/h2ooooooo/filezilla-js)

Packages: [`@jalsoedesign/filezilla-core`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jalsoedesign/filezilla-core), [`@jalsoedesign/filezilla-cli`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jalsoedesign/filezilla-cli).

## HeidiSQL JS

Database sessions and independent SSH tunnel profiles.

[API documentation](https://h2ooooooo.github.io/heidisql-js/api/) · [CLI documentation](https://h2ooooooo.github.io/heidisql-js/cli/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/h2ooooooo/heidisql-js)

Packages: [`@jalsoedesign/heidisql-core`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jalsoedesign/heidisql-core), [`@jalsoedesign/heidisql-cli`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jalsoedesign/heidisql-cli).

## jsbrains

IDE installations, deployments, saved credential status and Portline integration.

[API documentation](https://h2ooooooo.github.io/jsbrains/api/) · [CLI documentation](https://h2ooooooo.github.io/jsbrains/cli/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/h2ooooooo/jsbrains)

Packages: [`@jalsoedesign/jsbrains`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jalsoedesign/jsbrains), [`@jalsoedesign/jsbrains-cli`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jalsoedesign/jsbrains-cli), [`@jalsoedesign/jsbrains-portline`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jalsoedesign/jsbrains-portline), [`@jalsoedesign/jsbrains-portline-cli`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jalsoedesign/jsbrains-portline-cli).

## OpenSSH JS

SSH configuration profiles, identities, includes and jump hosts.

[API documentation](https://h2ooooooo.github.io/openssh-js/api/) · [CLI documentation](https://h2ooooooo.github.io/openssh-js/cli/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/h2ooooooo/openssh-js)

Packages: [`@jalsoedesign/openssh-core`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jalsoedesign/openssh-core), [`@jalsoedesign/openssh-cli`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jalsoedesign/openssh-cli).

## PuTTY and KiTTY JS

PuTTY and KiTTY profiles, native settings and storage discovery.

[API documentation](https://h2ooooooo.github.io/putty-js/api/) · [CLI documentation](https://h2ooooooo.github.io/putty-js/cli/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/h2ooooooo/putty-js)

Packages: [`@jalsoedesign/putty-core`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jalsoedesign/putty-core), [`@jalsoedesign/putty-cli`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jalsoedesign/putty-cli).

## WinSCP JS

WinSCP sessions, transfer profiles, SSH tunnels and native storage discovery.

[API documentation](https://h2ooooooo.github.io/winscp-js/api/) · [CLI documentation](https://h2ooooooo.github.io/winscp-js/cli/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/h2ooooooo/winscp-js)

Packages: [`@jalsoedesign/winscp-core`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jalsoedesign/winscp-core), [`@jalsoedesign/winscp-cli`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jalsoedesign/winscp-cli).

# Shared integration infrastructure

## Portline

Shared normalized connection profiles, metadata queries, credential resolution, guarded native writes and CLI infrastructure.

Packages: [`@jalsoedesign/portline-abstract`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jalsoedesign/portline-abstract), [`@jalsoedesign/portline-core`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jalsoedesign/portline-core), [`@jalsoedesign/portline-platform`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jalsoedesign/portline-platform), [`@jalsoedesign/portline-cli`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jalsoedesign/portline-cli).

[Documentation](/integration/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/h2ooooooo/portline)

## Portline Dockline bridge

Optional shared mapping and scoped file/SSH execution for normalized profiles from any application reader.

Packages: [`@jalsoedesign/portline-dockline`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jalsoedesign/portline-dockline).

[Documentation](https://h2ooooooo.github.io/portline/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/h2ooooooo/portline)

Directory contributions are described in [contributing](/integration/contributing).
